data.long_meaning: Nileshkumar is a Sanskrit name composed of two words: Nilesh and Kumar. Nilesh means 'Lord of the Gods', and Kumar refers to 'younger brother of God Shiva'. Thus, Nileshkumar represents the divine brother of the God of Destruction.
